verdict.rationale: LM Studio documents a REST API for driving local models from apps and scripts, plus OpenAI-like endpoints that can be served locally or on the network. It also offers a headless llmster daemon and service mode covering completions, chat, embeddings and structured outputs, with on-demand model loading, and an lms CLI for loading models and starting the server. Community users independently confirm the OpenAI-compatible API and the headless flow are usable from real tools. Missing for 10: an in-depth API reference in the evidence (endpoint schemas, auth, model-management endpoints), and SDK details.
